scripts.dev:backend: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,CATALOG,ORDER,PAYMENT,AI,NOTIF" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow,blue,green,red,gray" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:notification"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "FRONTEND,GATEWAY,AUTH,CATALOG,ORDER,PAYMENT,AI,NOTIF" -c "cyan,magenta,blue,yellow,green,red,magenta,gray" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:catalog" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:notification"
scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace=libs/common && npm run build --workspace=libs/auth
scripts.db:reset: npx prisma migrate reset --force --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && npm run db:seed
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules apps/backend/*/node_modules libs/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/build
